loops.reconciliationNote: Reconciliation diffs are exactly the interleaved recovery swap amounts (USDC diff -58613.21962723741 equals recovery swap input 58613.21962723741, WETH diff 24.19493261618493 equals recovery swap output 24.1949326161849), so balances reconcile fully once the recovery swap is accounted for. The callback executed at block 59508645, before the recovery swap landed at block 59508696, so no abort occurred.

negativeProof.verdict: PASS: guardian priced the in band Sync (lastPrice updated) and did not fire; no Triggered event, no callback

abortProof.detail: Stop loss triggered at 2300 (origin block 59508639). Guardian trigger was observed on Lasna and a recovery buy back to 3000 was sent immediately, but the recovery swap only landed at Base block 59508696 while the callback executed at block 59508645, six blocks after the origin swap. The full detect plus recovery path took about 57 Base blocks, far longer than the 6 block callback latency, so a manual or scripted recovery cannot beat the callback on this deployment. The abort path itself is covered by unit tests in the callback test suite (price back inside the band and trigger kind changed cases).
